label: shared_bucket_access setting (Sync Gateway)
type: the per-database setting controlling whether Sync Gateway and Couchbase Server applications share the same bucket. Changes the physical shape of a deletion (sgw:tombstone's isVariantOf relation to storage:tombstone is conditioned on this setting being true) and the impact of expiry() reaching its TTL.
note: The setting behind this round's headline tombstone finding - see sgw:tombstone.
